title: Fake News Detection Using Machine Learning
summary: An NLP capstone project that classifies news articles as Real or Fake using SVM and Logistic Regression with TF-IDF features, deployed as a Streamlit web app. The dependency string 'more-itertools' in requirements.txt happens to contain the substring 'sdv' as part of a local file path, with no actual SDV package imported or used.
evidence: requirements.txt: more-itertools @ file:///.../abs_e2687gwsdv/... — 'sdv' is a substring of a random temp folder name, not the SDV library
